intro: Trying to find Colorado scholarships for applicants with financial need without wading through high-award national results? This filtered USA view narrows the search to programs with listed awards under the larger-dollar range, so you can compare options that may fit local or state-connected applicants more closely. The rows below span areas such as education, community, medicine, STEM, disability, and miscellaneous topics, with examples tied to college, graduate, adult non-traditional, and high school senior paths. Awards vary by listing, deadlines differ by program, and eligibility ScholarshipTop organizes available details as part of application planning from row to row. Many listings in this slice appear to have lighter application signals and often no essay flag, but you should still read each requirement line carefully before you apply.
